meta.title: Git marks
meta.description: Annotate Markdown previews with the changes of the working tree relative to the last commit (HEAD): deletions show as red strikethrough, additions as green text, whole deleted lines reappear struck out in red, and untracked files are marked line-by-line green. The marks live in a generated copy that is never committed back — source files are never rewritten. Pair it with the "Git-marked copy" button in dsh-better-sidebar; the full Markdown grammar (tables, code highlighting, KaTeX, mermaid) is preserved.
